headline: Building a sustainable 1% ROA franchise, with focus on improving core profitability

highlights: Key Points  We recently met the senior management team of Punjab National Bank (PNB), including MD & CEO Mr Ashok Chandra and CFO Mr Raman Grover.

The management remains focused on building a sustainable earnings franchise through disciplined balance-sheet growth and a gradual shift towards higher-yielding businesses.  The key takeaway was management's confidence in sustaining ROA above 1%, driven by focus on improving core profitability.
PNB is prioritising profitable growth over headline loan growth by pruning low-yielding advances, while internal balance-sheet optimisation and rate hikes should support NIM recovery.
Loan growth is expected to normalise towards system levels as the bank completes this pruning.
valuation: We maintain our BUY rating, with a revised target price of ₹146 (vs earlier Rs 137), based on ~0.9x Sep-28E ABV (vs. ~0.85x earlier).

CMP: Rs126 | Target Price (TP): Rs146 | Upside: 16% November 06, 2026 Institutional Equities Punjab National Bank (PNB) 2 Asset quality outlook remains benign, supported by strong underwriting and high provisioning coverage.

The RAM portfolio currently constitutes 57% of advances, with the management targeting a gradual increase to 60%, alongside a 40% corporate portfolio, with a greater focus on higher-yielding MSME advances.
